notes: Chapter 1 second scripted battle; CRT path matched live-second-5120.json on 2026-09-27.
Default level two, original equipment; separate level-one variant for openings without the overkill EXP bonus.
Event 0600 command 8900 unlocks Pirro job 18 skill index 2 (Pierce Through).
Pierce Through: min(current HP, maximum HP * percentage / 100), integer division; CalcType 2 skips critical and variance rolls.
